segments.comment: Independent item-actions lookup: the inventory menu picks the stethoscope, its item-actions menu's '/' queues dowhatis with the canned keys 'i' and 'c' (iactions.c itemactions_pushkeys), and pager.c do_look()'s 'i' arm reads both through display_inventory() and shows the data.base entry; the search afterwards shows the canned queue is spent.
